description: A hand needle carrying silk or thread, used to draw the working strand through the sections and around the core when sewing a headband. A second needle set vertically can pin the core in place while the first stitches are formed.
name: needle

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XI, p.148. Internet Archive.
